title: Classical commentary
shortSummary: Commentary organizes classics, inherited interpretation, textual criticism and teaching into transmissible knowledge structures.
curatorialDescription: The concept treats classical learning as an editorial and educational practice rather than a static list of books.
researchNote: Future records must separate individual classics, editions, commentators and institutional uses.
